card.name: Inside capitalized warning-header words
card.fires_on: Partway through long medical words written in all capitals in boxed warning headings, such as EMBRY-O-FETAL or EXACER-B-ATION. It fires on the middle piece, not the start or end of the word.

modes.label: EMBRYO-FETAL header
modes.description: The letter O completing EMBRY in the all-caps heading EMBRYO-FETAL TOXICITY.
modes.example: WARNING: CARDIOMYOPATHY, INFUSION REACTIONS, EMBRY<<O>>-FETAL TOXICITY,

modes.label: EXACERBATION header
modes.description: The letter B in the middle of EXACERBATION(S) in the hepatitis B warning heading.
modes.example: WARNING: POST TREATMENT ACUTE EXACER<<B>>ATION OF HEPATITIS B

modes.label: Transfusional
modes.description: The middle piece of Transfusional in a dosage heading about iron overload.
